ceo_directive: Make the retroactive scanner a permanent CI gate

ci_fail_conditions.detection: evidence entry has model_derived=True but source_type starts with 'primary' OR primary_source_count includes model_derived entries
evidence entry lacks artifact_pointer or content_hash
102 matrix has EXPRESS disclosure with empty claim_number

ci_fail_conditions.condition: reused generic passages across multiple limitations
ci_fail_conditions.detection: same content_hash appears for >1 limitation_id without independent rationale
102 entry cites >1 reference for a single limitation
103 result lacks explicit motivation state (FOUND / NOT_FOUND_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH / SEARCH_INCOMPLETE)

ci_fail_conditions.condition: score/status contradiction (gate says PASS but score < threshold)
inconsistent artifact hashes (SHA256SUMS doesn't match actual files)
ci_fail_conditions.detection: recorded hash in SHA256SUMS != actual file hash

ci_integration: Add to .github/workflows/ci.yml or pre-commit hook: python3 protocol/governance/RETROACTIVE_INFLATION_SCANNER.py
exit_code: 0 = PASS (no CRITICAL/HIGH findings), 1 = FAIL (CRITICAL/HIGH findings present)
